description: Complete and format a legal discovery timeline by: (1) removing draft instruction section, (2) integrating additional events from notes file on Desktop into the timeline table in chronological order, (3) completing any incomplete entries (filling missing dates/descriptions/exhibits), (4) ensuring all events are in chronological order, (5) fixing formatting inconsistencies (bold dates, consistent style), and (6) saving the final document.
